source: consultas de los visuales del informe Ventas Retail

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Fecha'[Año-mes], "Ventas", [Ventas], "Ventas año anterior", [Ventas año anterior])
EVALUATE __DS0Core ORDER BY 'Fecha'[Año-mes] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Tienda'[Región], "Ventas", [Ventas])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Tienda'[Región] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Producto'[Categoría], "Ventas", [Ventas], "Margen", [Margen])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Producto'[Categoría] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Canal'[Canal], "Ventas", [Ventas])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Canal'[Canal] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"2026"}, 'Fecha'[Año])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Ventas", [Ventas], "Crecimiento %", [Crecimiento %], "Margen %", [Margen %], "Unidades", [Unidades], "Cuota online %", [Cuota online %])

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"2026"}, 'Fecha'[Año])
VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Fecha'[Año-mes], __DS0FilterTable, "Ventas", [Ventas], "Ventas año anterior", [Ventas año anterior])
EVALUATE __DS0Core ORDER BY 'Fecha'[Año-mes] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"2026"}, 'Fecha'[Año])
VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Tienda'[Región], __DS0FilterTable, "Ventas", [Ventas])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Tienda'[Región] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"2026"}, 'Fecha'[Año])
VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Producto'[Categoría], __DS0FilterTable, "Ventas", [Ventas], "Margen", [Margen])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Producto'[Categoría] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"2026"}, 'Fecha'[Año])
VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Canal'[Canal], __DS0FilterTable, "Ventas", [Ventas])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Canal'[Canal] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(ROLLUPGROUP('Tienda'[Tienda], 'Tienda'[Región]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"), "Ventas", [Ventas], "Crecimiento %", [Crecimiento %], "Margen %", [Margen %], "Cuota online %", [Cuota online %])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(502, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, [Ventas] DESC

DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Tienda'[Formato], "Ventas", [Ventas])
VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas], 0)
EVALUATE __DS0PrimaryWindowed ORDER BY [Ventas] DESC, 'Tienda'[Formato] ASC

DEFINE VAR __DS0Core = SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Producto'[Producto], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"), "Ventas", [Ventas], "Unidades", [Unidades], "Margen %", [Margen %])
